newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo to pay slightly higher dividends.
newsitem.headline: Akzo to pay slightly higher dividends.

text.p: Chemicals group Akzo Nobel said on Thursday it would pay a slightly higher dividend in future to reflect its reduced cyclicality.

"In the past our dividend policy was based on 30-40 percent (of profits) -- henceforth this will more likely be 40 percent or more...in line with the less cyclical nature of the business compared to the past," Akzo chairman Cornelis van Lede told a results news conference.
Akzo said earlier it was lifting its 1996 dividend to 7.50 guilders per share from 7.00 guilders in 1995 despite virtually flat full-year net profits of 1.318 billion guilders.
